arguments.decision: Where should the new PS-ADPCM audio structure/decoder verification live relative to the already-reviewed milestone-#2 evidence pipeline?
arguments.evidence: Milestone #2's format contract for sound banks (tools/format_contracts.py bank()) explicitly returns payload_codec='unknown' and its README and issue say 'No payload codec or playback claim'; its committed results/hashes (formats-result.json etc.) and the escalated-then-reasoner-resolved completion gate are bound to the current contract. verify_formats.py has families archive/bank/model/sprite/corpus and writes immutable result dirs through evidence_common.write_result (pass=0, fail=1, incomplete=2). New measurements (offline, real corpus): all 305 bank descriptor spans and all 20 .mib streams show 0 PS-ADPCM rule violations; .mih word5 equals the number of 0x8000-byte interleave turns in 20/20 files; decoded clip fraction max 0.00026. New module tools/spu_adpcm.py (structure(), decode(), deinterleave(), mih_fields()) already written and not yet tested or committed. Issue #2 lists audio codec as a separate investigation and its acceptance requires audio decoding not be implied by the milestone claims.
arguments.priorities: Do not invalidate or silently alter existing milestone evidence or its hashes. Keep results immutable and separated by interface (static/runtime/formats stay separate). Smallest public-seam change with negative/boundary tests. New claims must be bounded and not imply playback correctness.

candidates.description: Add a new separate CLI tools/verify_audio.py (bank and music subcommands) using evidence_common.write_result and tools/spu_adpcm.py, with its own result directory and tests; leave format_contracts.py/verify_formats.py and milestone evidence untouched.
Change format_contracts.bank() to also check ADPCM structure and set payload_codec, extending verify_formats.py; this alters the contract the milestone evidence was bound to.
Record the measurements only in a notes markdown file with no executable verifier.
Do not implement anything until more audio evidence (e.g. EE/IOP code references to SPU2 upload) is collected.

requirements: Existing milestone-#2 result files, hashes and their claims remain valid and unmodified.
The new claim is bounded to structural/decoder-sanity and implies no playback or in-game correctness.
